program.name: late_stack_after_shields
program.why: Keep hydra out of the 7-range cone until zealots have already eaten the first splash volleys, then everyone attack-moves so remaining DPS is continuous.

program.name: funnel_then_stack
program.why: Stay back and spread until they are packed in the neck; then attack-move so splash never stops and remaining DPS is continuous while rotating wounded bodies out of blade range.

program.name: threat_focus_then_stack
program.why: Pick off the highest DPS-per-HP (hydras) first with stutter fire, then stack and clump-detonate once they start bleeding.

program.name: hydra_dps_kite_then_commit
program.why: Hydras are the highest DPS-per-HP and we outrange them; stutter-kite threat until they bleed, then attack-move so cooldowns never idle.

program.name: concave_then_hold_gap
program.why: Fan a ring so all six guns fire at once while still far, then freeze at the mouth so melee cannot surround; always pick the densest body for any splash from overlapping shots.

program.name: funnel_stack_clump_splash
program.why: Retreat until they squeeze into the neck then attack-move so colossus splash never idles on the densest pack while hydras keep firing.

program.name: rally_wall_anchor
program.why: Walk back to the wall/rally immediately, hold ground, and only shoot what enters 7-range so hydras must funnel into the bar.

program.name: bane_clump_charge_marines_guns
program.why: Walk banelings and zealots into the densest hydra/stalker pack for splash detonations while marines stutter-kite guns so melee never eats the backline.

program.name: fall_then_hold_mouth
program.why: Walk away first so packed bodies unclump and enemy suicide is strung out, then freeze and shoot into range; never chase so melee never closes on even speed.

program.name: fan_then_freeze_gap
program.why: Open a concave while still far so all marauders fire together, then freeze because standing keeps melee out; dump bonus damage into armored stalkers first.

program.name: bait_two_concave
program.why: Two closest melee walk into their baneling clump; remaining zealots hold outside blast while hydra fans a concave and kites, focusing clump then frontline.

program.name: hold_delete_weakest
program.why: Same funnel, but always snipe lowest-HP armored in range so medivac overheal snowballs a count flip before their extra guns matter.

program.name: frontline_then_weakest_hold
program.why: Chunk the nearest hydra while far, then freeze and pick lowest-hp already in range so leftover banelings arrive after guns are gone.

program.name: concave_ring_at_mouth
program.why: Fan into a ring at the mouth of the choke so all four hydras shoot together, then stutter if melee pressure never arrives.

program.name: late_rotate_after_first_volleys
program.why: Close with stack while shields are still up; once trading starts, peel only the sub-40% hydra so remaining guns stay on cooldown.

program.name: mouth_concave_clump
program.why: Park a wide ring at the mouth so all three lasers see the same blob, then concave-stutter if they try to wrap; splash on clump still wins the count even while they outnumber.

program.name: stutter_bait_gun_kite
program.why: Only the nearest gun walks as bait while others take safe 0.5s shots; zealots charge to occupy melee so the colossus keeps range; switch to threat once blades arrive.

program.name: fall_then_stack_clump
program.why: Retreat until they string, then attack-move so colossus splash never idles on the densest pack while hydras keep firing and wounded peel.

program.name: threat_focus_and_rotate
program.why: Always shoot the highest dps-per-hp unit; peel sub-40% marines so the remaining guns keep uptime.

program.name: bait_one_stutter_frontline
program.why: The nearest marine always walks as bait so marauders waste shots; remaining guns stutter-fire the front marauder while zealots crash in.

program.name: bait_one_gun_hold_rest
program.why: Sacrifice the closest stalker as a walking bait so zealots chase a single body while the other eight hold a safe ring and delete guns.

program.name: bane_crash_bar_clump
program.why: Send all banelings into the marine ball for chain splash while the colossus bars the densest pack and our marines hold the line; no kiting because they have no melee.

program.name: lings_crash_stutter_marauders
program.why: Zerglings close the far gap immediately while the two guns stutter-kite so they never tank marauder concussive; we snipe the nearest marauder first because it is the tankiest DPS.

program.name: hold_mouth_weakest_bar
program.why: Stand ground at the gap, never step forward; always paint the lowest-HP body already in range so overlapping colossus bars finish wounded lings before they touch zealots.

program.name: concave_clump_commit
program.why: Fan a ring immediately so all 11 hydras fire together into the densest pack; no retreat because falling back lets stalker range farm us.

program.name: concave_bar_lings_first
program.why: Colossus light bonus and splash want the densest ling pack immediately; fan then freeze and paint the bar across the blob so hydras walk into a thinned melee wave.

program.name: stack_frontline_rotate
program.why: Stack attack-move on the nearest damage-dealer whenever a gun is ready so cooldowns are used; banes always charge; peel sub-40% ranged off zealot reach.

program.name: heaviest_then_weakest_stack
program.why: While out of range stack-attack-move onto the tankiest stalker to start the trade; once anyone can shoot, freeze on lowest-hp already in range so splash waste is avoided and banes are last.

program.name: full_charge_stutter_kiting
program.why: Dump all allied banelings into theirs immediately while stalkers purely stutter-kite and pick weakest already in range, using speed to reopen the gap after each volley.

program.name: weakest_first_concave
program.why: Fan then always delete the lowest-HP hydra already in range so count flips before their extra two bodies fire a full volley.

program.name: heaviest_bait_then_wipe
program.why: Focus the tankiest remaining bane so the first explosion is the most valuable; two lings bait, the rest wait then charge the survivors.

program.name: bait_two_then_stutter_threat
program.why: Two closest zealots walk into the densest baneling group so detonations happen on cheap shields; remaining melee freeze; guns stutter and always pick highest DPS-per-HP stalker.

program.name: frontline_hold_splash
program.why: Chunk the nearest hydra at range, then stand-ground with pack lasers so colossus splash and stalker bonus vs armored finish the remaining stalker while banes are still walking.
